say:29:1610546521:1.text: Once you've given your information, please remain in place until you receive further instructions.
say:29:1610546521:1.source_cn: 登记完信息的人，也……暂时听副校长的指令。留在原地等候...

say:32:1610546522:1.text: You see Cyran walk toward the headmaster's body. Trailing him at a cautious distance is Zorya; she is clearly observing his every move.
say:32:1610546522:1.source_cn: 你看到迪尔格雷走向了校长的尸体，佐尔娅似乎也注意到了这...
say:32:1610546522:1.male: You see Cyran walk toward the headmaster's body. Trailing him at a cautious distance is Zorya; she is clearly observing his every move.
say:32:1610546522:1.female: You see Cyran walk toward the headmaster's body. Trailing him at a cautious distance is Zorya; she is clearly observing his every move.

say:34:1610546523:1.text: You quietly move closer, unnoticed by the Lyceum guards, trying to observe Cyran's next action.
say:34:1610546523:1.source_cn: 你不动声色地打量着四周，趁着莱希拉姆守卫不注意，也走向...
say:34:1610546523:1.male: You quietly move closer, unnoticed by the Lyceum guards, trying to observe Cyran's next action.
say:34:1610546523:1.female: You quietly move closer, unnoticed by the Lyceum guards, trying to observe Cyran's next action.

narration:0:16010572:0.text: Cyran kneels to examine the headmaster's body. Zorya approaches, and he rises to speak with her.
narration:0:16010572:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷蹲下检查校长遗体，此时佐尔娅靠近，迪尔格雷随即...

say:2:1610547501:1.text: Ah... Professor Zorya, my old mentor. Perfect timing.
say:2:1610547501:1.source_cn: 啊……佐尔娅女士，我旧日的恩师，你来得正好。

say:3:1610547502:1.text: I have many questions about what just happened. But above all, why has Headmaster Leymar ended up like this? Perhaps you can enlighten me?
say:3:1610547502:1.source_cn: 关于现在正发生的情况，我有很多疑问。但最大的问题是，雷...

say:4:1610547503:1.text: An investigation is already underway to determine exactly that. I have no answers yet.

say:5:1610547504:1.text: Excellent. Then let's see where this investigation takes us.
say:5:1610547504:1.source_cn: 真好，看来我们就这个问题达成一致了。

say:6:1610547505:1.text: Magic is a profound and mysterious thing. It can achieve wonders that ordinary people call impossible.
say:6:1610547505:1.source_cn: 魔法是一门深奥且奇妙的学问，它能做到许多普通人看来荒诞...

say:7:1610547506:1.text: It can turn falsehood into truth, or even bring the dead back to life... But, a disguise is still a disguise. It cracks eventually. Don't you agree, Professor Zorya?
say:7:1610547506:1.source_cn: 它能将假变成真，坏转为好，甚至将生死颠倒……但伪装就是...

say:8:1610547507:1.text: If you're talking about those who disguise their crimes, or villains posing as heroes, then yes. Their deceit always comes to light.
say:8:1610547507:1.source_cn: 如果你说的是那些伪装成无辜者的凶手，或是伪装成善良人的...

say:9:1610547508:1.text: But I remember teaching you this: not all disguises are born of malice. Motives and actions are two very different things.
say:9:1610547508:1.source_cn: 但我曾经教过你，“伪装”的目的并非都是邪恶的。动机与行...

say:10:1610547509:1.text: Of course, Professor. I remember your teachings well. Perhaps that lesson could use a refresher, though. Surely, over the years, you've seen disguises that weren't evil. Care to share a few examples with your old student?
say:10:1610547509:1.source_cn: 当然，老师，我记得很清楚。我想当年的课程可以加一点课时...

say:11:1610547510:1.text: I think it's better that you discover those on your own. That's the best way to learn a lesson. For now, I think we have more pressing matters to attend to.
say:11:1610547510:1.source_cn: 或许你以后会见识到，但不是现在。眼下我们还有更紧迫的事...

say:13:1610547511:1.text: Sorry to interrupt, Magister Cyran. We need your advice on the selection exam...
say:13:1610547511:1.source_cn: ——很抱歉打断你们的谈话，迪尔格雷大人。宫廷魔法师选拔...

say:14:1610547512:1.text: With such an incident, I suggest that the exam be suspended until the investigation is concluded.
say:14:1610547512:1.source_cn: 出现了这么严重的事故，选拔赛就先暂停吧。等什么时候我们...

say:15:1610547513:1.text: Of course, Magister Cyran. I will inform the students.
say:15:1610547513:1.source_cn: 好的，迪尔格雷大人。我会向大家宣布这个决定。

say:16:1610547514:1.text: Cyran casts a glance at Durella, then shifts his gaze toward the ground. Following his look, you see the Arcane Disruptor lying there.
say:16:1610547514:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷看了杜瑞拉一眼，然后又将目光转向另一边。你顺着...
say:16:1610547514:1.male: Cyran casts a glance at Durella, then shifts his gaze toward the ground. Following his look, you see the Arcane Disruptor lying there.
say:16:1610547514:1.female: Cyran casts a glance at Durella, then shifts his gaze toward the ground. Following his look, you see the Arcane Disruptor lying there.

say:17:1610547515:1.text: That device clearly played a key role in this incident. It interrupted the spell Zorya placed on the headmaster, revealing his true condition in front of everyone.
say:17:1610547515:1.source_cn: 校长死亡暴露的确与反魔法射线装置有着直接的联系——它阻...

say:19:1610547516:1.text: Did Silven really use it by coincidence, or did he know exactly what he was doing? And was that tense exchange between Cyran and Zorya connected to all this somehow? How about Cyran's signal to Durella...?
say:19:1610547516:1.source_cn: 休选择使用反魔法射线装置来阻止莱希拉姆守卫，他的行动真...

say:20:1610547517:1.text: You feel yourself lost in a fog of mysteries. Perhaps you should examine the <style="highlight">small Arcane Disruptor</style> yourself...
say:20:1610547517:1.source_cn: 你感觉自己陷入了无尽的迷雾之中。或许你也应该仔细检查一...
say:20:1610547517:1.male: You feel yourself lost in a fog of mysteries. Perhaps you should examine the <style="highlight">small Arcane Disruptor</style> yourself...
say:20:1610547517:1.female: You feel yourself lost in a fog of mysteries. Perhaps you should examine the <style="highlight">small Arcane Disruptor</style> yourself...

say:0:1610548001:2.text: The energy core inside the device is completely spent. It was designed for single-use only. You spot a small label underneath, marked with the Serene Lyceum museum's collection code.
say:0:1610548001:2.source_cn: 这枚反魔法射线装置里的能量已经耗尽了，它是一次性的魔法...

say:0:1610548001:2.female: The energy core inside the device is completely spent. It was designed for single-use only. You spot a small label underneath, marked with the Serene Lyceum museum's collection code.

say:2:1610548002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that's an important piece of evidence! You are not allowed to touch that!
say:2:1610548002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that's an important piece of evidence! You are not allowed to touch that!
say:2:1610548002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that's an important piece of evidence! You are not allowed to touch that!

say:3:1610548003:1.text: Hand it to me. I will pass it to the investigation team for further examination.
say:3:1610548003:1.source_cn: 把它交给我，它会作为现场证物提交给调查组，进行后续检查。
say:3:1610548003:1.male: Hand it to me. I will pass it to the investigation team for further examination.
say:3:1610548003:1.female: Hand it to me. I will pass it to the investigation team for further examination.

say:6:1610548005:2.text: Good. Now, everyone listen up! I have an announcement to make!
say:6:1610548005:2.source_cn: 这还差不多。你们都禁止离开，我将要宣布重要消息！
say:6:1610548005:2.male: Good. Now, everyone listen up! I have an announcement to make!
say:6:1610548005:2.female: Good. Now, everyone listen up! I have an announcement to make!

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: （不情愿地将反魔法射线装置递给她）

say:1:1610549001:1.text: Listen carefully: due to the severity of this incident, the <style="highlight">Court Mage Selection Exam is immediately suspended</style>!
say:1:1610549001:1.source_cn: 我再重复一遍，由于突然重大事故，<style=high...

say:2:1610549002:1.text: All candidates here must log their information with the guards, and assemble at <style="highlight">Verity Plaza</style> tomorrow morning. No candidates are allowed to leave the Lyceum without permission.
say:2:1610549002:1.source_cn: 今日所有在现场的考生立刻登记身份，明早在<style=...

say:4:1610549003:1.text: Madam Durella, what about Headmaster Leymar and Niall? Are they alright?
say:4:1610549003:1.source_cn: 杜瑞拉女士，雷蒙校长和尼尔，他们现在怎么样了？

say:5:1610549004:1.text: That is not your concern. Focus on doing exactly as you are told.
say:5:1610549004:1.source_cn: 不要多问！你们现在该关心的不是这些。

say:6:1610549005:1.text: Guards, bring Niall to the infirmary for treatment.
say:6:1610549005:1.source_cn: 守卫，把尼尔送去校医那里进行治疗。

say:7:1610549006:1.text: All staff and faculty, return to your offices. We're holding an urgent meeting to discuss follow-up actions.
say:7:1610549006:1.source_cn: 其余教师和职工尽快返回办公室，我们需要尽快召集教职工会...

say:8:1610549007:1.text: Wait, what about the headmaster? Is he being treated? You don't mean...
say:8:1610549007:1.source_cn: 等等，那雷蒙校长呢？校长不需要送去治疗？难道他——

say:10:1610549008:1.text: Students! The headmaster holds a special status. Royal healers from the royal capital are already on their way. Please understand that we're only following the standard procedure.
say:10:1610549008:1.source_cn: ——各位考生，不必惊慌！校长身份特殊，将会有医师从首都...

say:11:1610549009:1.text: Zorya, I have arranged for staff to take care of the students here. As a senior professor, you are needed at the faculty meeting. Come with me at once.
say:11:1610549009:1.source_cn: 佐尔娅，我已经安排了人手在这里安抚学生。作为资深教授，...

say:13:1610549011:1.text: Students, although the exam is suspended, you should continue your studies. You can always go study in the <style="highlight">library</style>, and keep practicing your spells.
say:13:1610549011:1.source_cn: 同学们，选拔虽然暂停，但你们要记得去<style=hi...
say:13:1610549011:1.male: Students, although the exam is suspended, you should continue your studies. You can always go study in the <style="highlight">library</style>, and keep practicing your spells.
say:13:1610549011:1.female: Students, although the exam is suspended, you should continue your studies. You can always go study in the <style="highlight">library</style>, and keep practicing your spells.

say:14:1610549012:1.text: Do not let this incident shake your resolve for studying magic.
say:14:1610549012:1.source_cn: 不要因为这起意外，动摇你们的心。
say:14:1610549012:1.male: Do not let this incident shake your resolve for studying magic.
say:14:1610549012:1.female: Do not let this incident shake your resolve for studying magic.

say:15:1610549013:1.text: That's enough. Let's go! I must inform the Academy Board of this!
say:15:1610549013:1.source_cn: 行了，不用担心这些考生们的学业。快走吧，我还要尽快向校...

say:17:1610549014:1.text: You can't approach Professor Zorya here, but the way she mentioned the library... Perhaps she's hinting for you to meet her later in the lounge there.
say:17:1610549014:1.source_cn: 你没法在此处和佐尔娅老师密谈，但她刚才特地强调了图书馆...
say:17:1610549014:1.male: You can't approach Professor Zorya here, but the way she mentioned the library... Perhaps she's hinting for you to meet her later in the lounge there.
say:17:1610549014:1.female: You can't approach Professor Zorya here, but the way she mentioned the library... Perhaps she's hinting for you to meet her later in the lounge there.

say:20:1610549015:4.text: You glance over your fellow students. Most are still frozen in shock and disbelief; the sight of the headmaster collapsing will stay with them for a long time.
say:20:1610549015:4.source_cn: 你扭头看向一起考试的同伴们，大部分人的脸上还残留着震惊...
say:20:1610549015:4.male: You glance over your fellow students. Most are still frozen in shock and disbelief; the sight of the headmaster collapsing will stay with them for a long time.
say:20:1610549015:4.female: You glance over your fellow students. Most are still frozen in shock and disbelief; the sight of the headmaster collapsing will stay with them for a long time.

say:21:1610549016:1.text: They are still only students, after all. Now, it's your turn to step up and act like the "adult" here.
say:21:1610549016:1.source_cn: 他们毕竟只是一群尚未毕业的孩子。现在，该你这位“大人”...
say:21:1610549016:1.male: They are still only students, after all. Now, it's your turn to step up and act like the "adult" here.
say:21:1610549016:1.female: They are still only students, after all. Now, it's your turn to step up and act like the "adult" here.

say:1:1610549501:1.text: Everyone... Let's get out of here.
say:1:1610549501:1.source_cn: 各位……我们需要换个环境。

say:2:1610549502:1.text: Just closing my eyes brings back the scene just now. I'm sure you all feel the same.
say:2:1610549502:1.source_cn: 只要闭上眼睛，就能想起刚才的景象……恐怕你们也是一样吧。
say:2:1610549502:1.male: Just closing my eyes brings back the scene just now. I'm sure you all feel the same.
say:2:1610549502:1.female: Just closing my eyes brings back the scene just now. I'm sure you all feel the same.

say:4:1610549503:1.text: Y-Yes. I can't stop thinking about it!

say:5:1610549504:1.text: Exactly. We're all scared and shaken right now. Let's take a walk through the Blooming Atelier, maybe it will clear our heads a bit.
say:5:1610549504:1.source_cn: 没错，现在我们都太害怕，太紧张了。我们需要离开这里，最...
say:5:1610549504:1.male: Exactly. We're all scared and shaken right now. Let's take a walk through the Blooming Atelier, maybe it will clear our heads a bit.
say:5:1610549504:1.female: Exactly. We're all scared and shaken right now. Let's take a walk through the Blooming Atelier, maybe it will clear our heads a bit.

say:7:1610549505:1.text: I don't know, but... Sure, that sounds like a good idea.
say:7:1610549505:1.source_cn: ……我现在脑子里很乱，我不知道……也许你说的有道理。

say:8:1610549506:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you want to join us?
say:8:1610549506:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you want to join us?
say:8:1610549506:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you want to join us?

choice_prompt:9:1610549506.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you want to join us?
choice_prompt:9:1610549506.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you want to join us?

say:10:1610549507:1.text: Look, we didn't cause any of this. Don't be so hard on yourselves.
say:10:1610549507:1.source_cn: 这件事不是我们任何一个人的错，不要给自己太大压力。
say:10:1610549507:1.male: Look, we didn't cause any of this. Don't be so hard on yourselves.
say:10:1610549507:1.female: Look, we didn't cause any of this. Don't be so hard on yourselves.

say:11:1610549508:1.text: Let's go. Try not to dwell on the incident.
say:11:1610549508:1.source_cn: 走吧，散步的时候就别想刚才的事情了。
say:11:1610549508:1.male: Let's go. Try not to dwell on the incident.
say:11:1610549508:1.female: Let's go. Try not to dwell on the incident.

choice:9:1:2.text: I could use a break from this.
choice:9:1:2.male: I could use a break from this.
choice:9:1:2.female: I could use a break from this.

say:0:1610550001:0.text: Let's go take a walk over there and clear our heads.
say:0:1610550001:0.source_cn: 我们去那边散散步，放松一下。
say:0:1610550001:0.male: Let's go take a walk over there and clear our heads.
say:0:1610550001:0.female: Let's go take a walk over there and clear our heads.

say:1:1610550501:1.text: I know everyone's tense, and honestly, so am I. I might look calm right now, but that's just me putting on an act.
say:1:1610550501:1.source_cn: 我知道大家都很紧张、很压抑，我也是……说实话，我现在这...

say:2:1610550502:1.text: Still, what's done is done. Panic solves nothing. Just remember: we are the Serene Lyceum's very best.
say:2:1610550502:1.source_cn: 可事情已经发生了，我们不能一直惊慌失措。再怎么说，我们...
say:2:1610550502:1.male: Still, what's done is done. Panic solves nothing. Just remember: we are the Serene Lyceum's very best.
say:2:1610550502:1.female: Still, what's done is done. Panic solves nothing. Just remember: we are the Serene Lyceum's very best.

say:3:1610550503:1.text: So we have to get it together, even if it means just faking it. We need to keep our composure.
say:3:1610550503:1.source_cn: 各位，我们得打起精神来。就算是只是暂时欺骗自己，也要表...
say:3:1610550503:1.male: So we have to get it together, even if it means just faking it. We need to keep our composure.
say:3:1610550503:1.female: So we have to get it together, even if it means just faking it. We need to keep our composure.

say:4:1610550504:1.text: We didn't do anything wrong. Silven, especially you. Trust me, whatever happened to Headmaster Leymar wasn't your fault.
say:4:1610550504:1.source_cn: 我们并没有做什么错事。休，尤其是你……相信我，发生在校...
say:4:1610550504:1.male: We didn't do anything wrong. Silven, especially you. Trust me, whatever happened to Headmaster Leymar wasn't your fault.
say:4:1610550504:1.female: We didn't do anything wrong. Silven, especially you. Trust me, whatever happened to Headmaster Leymar wasn't your fault.

say:6:1610550505:1.text: I still can't process this. Just this morning, we were escorting Princess Peggy around the art gallery... and now we're here.
say:6:1610550505:1.source_cn: ……真是没想到。早上我们陪着佩吉殿下参观的时候，谁都没...
say:6:1610550505:1.male: I still can't process this. Just this morning, we were escorting Princess Peggy around the art gallery... and now we're here.
say:6:1610550505:1.female: I still can't process this. Just this morning, we were escorting Princess Peggy around the art gallery... and now we're here.

say:8:1610550506:1.text: I know, right? This is way more stressful than any nightmare I've ever had!
say:8:1610550506:1.source_cn: 谁说不是呢，我连做梦都不会想到这样的情景……！

say:10:1610550507:1.text: That's odd. The Arcane Disruptor hit everyone here, yet only the headmaster collapsed. Could he be sick in some way?
say:10:1610550507:1.source_cn: 好奇怪，现场的每个人都和校长一样受到了反魔法射线的影响...
say:10:1610550507:1.male: That's odd. The Arcane Disruptor hit everyone here, yet only the headmaster collapsed. Could he be sick in some way?
say:10:1610550507:1.female: That's odd. The Arcane Disruptor hit everyone here, yet only the headmaster collapsed. Could he be sick in some way?

say:11:1610550508:1.text: The headmaster's face went white and rigid, almost like he was a corpse before he even hit the ground.
say:11:1610550508:1.source_cn: 校长倒下的时候我就在附近，我……呃，我看得很清楚，他倒...

say:12:1610550509:1.text: Madam Durella hasn't said it outright, but I think the headmaster might have...
say:12:1610550509:1.source_cn: 虽然杜瑞拉女士一直没有明说，但我觉得，校长、校长他可能……

say:14:1610550511:1.text: Let's not jump to conclusions. Maybe he's just fallen ill. He's a master of the arcane arts. There's no way a single Arcane Disruptor hit could harm him that badly.
say:14:1610550511:1.source_cn: 我们不要妄加猜测。可能只是校长本身抱恙，他懂的魔法比我...

say:15:1610550512:1.text: T-There's something else. When the headmaster collapsed, there was this sudden void of magic right around him, like something just vanished.
say:15:1610550512:1.source_cn: 我、我还看到了，校长倒下的时候，身上好像还有奇怪的魔力...

say:16:1610550513:1.text: Vanished...? Can you tell us more?
say:16:1610550513:1.source_cn: 奇怪的魔力？你能描述一下吗？

say:17:1610550514:1.text: I can't really describe it, but the magic I sensed was so much colder and creepier than anything normal. It was genuinely unsettling.
say:17:1610550514:1.source_cn: 我形容不出来，只觉得那不是我们常见的魔力……呃，总之就...

say:18:1610550515:1.text: Today's been too much for me... And I feel so bad for Niall. I really hope Professor Solise can heal him.
say:18:1610550515:1.source_cn: 今天的事情太突然了……对，还有尼尔，他也好可怜，不知道...

say:20:1610550516:1.text: I doubt it. There have been several cases of magic loss lately, four that I know of, and none of them have recovered.
say:20:1610550516:1.source_cn: 恐怕很难。这几个月出现过不少魔力消失的事情了，光是我见...

say:21:1610550517:1.source_cn: 那……那如果真的无法治愈，尼尔他……

say:23:1610550519:1.text: Expelled?! That's awful... Is that really the only option?
say:23:1610550519:1.source_cn: 退学？！好可怕的处理方式……只能这样了吗？
